title: Check candidate identities over an explicit model scope
statement: The Interpretation and validation Module shall report missing identities and identities shared by distinct entities in a supplied candidate model, and shall claim model-wide identity uniqueness only after inspecting the complete required scope.

what.problem: A partial or name-based check can accept conflicting engineering identities.
what.desired_outcome: Identity findings establish the inspected candidate scope and expose missing or conflicting identities.

why.rationale: SR-002 assigns uniqueness to entity identities independently of names, types, and locations.

conditions: A candidate model or definition change requires identity checking.

how.approach: Compare explicit identities across the supplied candidate view and return state-bound findings and completeness separately.

how_much.scope: Identity presence and uniqueness only; broader conformance, engineering adequacy, and approval are separate conclusions.

acceptance_criteria: An entity with no nonblank identity is identified as invalid for identity purposes.
Distinct entities with the same identity are reported as a conflict even when their names, types, or locations differ.
Equal names with distinct identities are permitted.
Unavailable portions produce an incomplete result rather than model-wide uniqueness; findings identify the inspected candidate state.

sources.basis: Derived from SR-002 for the proposed MOD-003 responsibility and IR-001 scenario walkthrough. Acceptance criteria are intended observations, not executed verification or an approval.
